name: Jesuit Missions of the Guaranis: San Ignacio Mini, Santa Ana, Nuestra Señora de Loreto and Santa Maria Mayor (Argentina), Ruins of Sao Miguel das Missoes (Brazil)
description: Five ruined Jesuit missions lie scattered through subtropical forest across northeastern Argentina and southern Brazil: San Ignacio Miní, Santa Ana, Loreto and Santa María la Mayor, plus São Miguel das Missões. Built in the 17th and 18th centuries as settlements for the Guaraní people, each has its own layout and state of preservation. Together they show how the Jesuits' experiment in mission life flourished until the order's expulsion.
